text.p: JP Morgan said it had reiterated its buy recomendation on Telebras after the stock fell eight percent Thursday following comments from a director who said the company was under pressure to reduce tariffs.

-- Analysts Simon Flannery and Jeannette Baez said they were maintaining their buy recomendation because they did not expect Telebras to implement across the board tariff reductions in its core wireline business.
-- They said the company had indicated a couple of weeks ago that it was very likely to cut wireless tariffs to compete against new B Band carriers.
-- they said they would maintain their 12-month target price of $170.
-- the analysts said Telebras "remains one of the cheapest stocks in our universe, with some of the highest pent-up demand."
